description: Links a virtual network to a private DNS zone.

name.description: (Required) The name of the virtual network link. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

private_dns_zone_name.description: (Required) The name of the Private DNS Zone (must be a valid domain name). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
private_dns_zone_name.title: Private dns zone name

registration_enabled.description: (Optional) Is auto-registration of virtual machine records in the virtual network in the Private DNS zone enabled?
registration_enabled.title: Registration enabled

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

virtual_network_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Virtual Network that should be linked to the DNS Zone.
virtual_network_id.title: Virtual network id

title: Private DNS Zone VNet Link
